name: MERIDIAN PRIME NEURAL
description: Vantablack Media's flagship neural-feed broadcast network, reaching an estimated 4.2 million subscribers across Tiers 3-5. Operates under the Sable Charter's licensed immersive content provisions and sets the industry standard for full-sensory production quality. Its programming slate dominates prime immersion hours with drama, sports, and corporate lifestyle content.
cultural_impact: Established the neural-feed broadcast format as the prestige tier of M88 entertainment, effectively making flat-screen consumption a class marker.
story_hooks: A content compliance officer discovers a recurring encoded pattern in the neural stream that doesn't match any approved subliminal template — and no one at Vantablack will answer her queries.
A small independent producer is offered a distribution deal through Meridian Prime Neural, only to find the contract includes a permanent rights transfer clause buried in subsection 44(c).
The network's flagship drama is interrupted mid-immersion by an unexplained 11-second intrusion feed — the same 11 seconds, repeated on three consecutive nights.
